description:

- RFC 5280 §4.2.1.13 — CRLDistributionPoints extension
- RFC 5280 §4.2.1.15 — FreshestCRL extension (delta CRL pointer)

- RFC 5280 §5.2.6 — Issuing Distribution Point extension

- RFC 5280 §6.3.3 — CRL path validation
- PKITS section 4.5 — CRL distribution points test vectors
- PKITS section 4.7 — delta CRL test vectors
title: Revocation completeness (delta CRLs, CDP)
